schedule_items.description: PHASE 1: INCEPTION & MOBILIZATION
Kick-off Meeting & Stakeholder Mobilization (Client Agency)
Methodology Refinement & Data Collection Plan
DELIVERABLE 1: INCEPTION REPORT (Due Week 2)
PHASE 2: ASSESSMENT & OPTIONS ANALYSIS
Assessment of Government Gateway (GG): Tech Audit of existing APIs, hardware, and licensing
Business Needs Mapping: Workshops with Key Line Ministries
Options Analysis: Comparison of GSB options (Commercial vs. Open Source/X-Road) & Costing (TCO)
Workshop 1: "As-Is" Findings & "To-Be" Options Validation
DELIVERABLE 2: 1ST INTERIM REPORT (GG Assessment & Options) (Due Week 10)
PHASE 3: FRAMEWORK DESIGN & CONCEPTUAL MODEL
Legal Interoperability Layer: "Digital Check" of legislation & drafting EIF-aligned legal principles
Organizational Layer: Defining SLAs and Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) Guidelines
Semantic Layer: Defining "Core Person/Business" Data Standards
Technical Layer: Security, Cryptography, and Transport Standards (ISO 27001)
Workshop 2: Framework Governance & Conceptual Model Review
DELIVERABLE 3: 2ND INTERIM REPORT (Framework Design & EIF Mapping) (Due Week 20)
PHASE 4: FINAL SPECIFICATIONS & TRANSITION
Drafting Technical Specifications: Functional/Non-Functional Reqs for the new Platform (RFB inputs)
Transition Planning: Migration strategy for existing services to the new Platform
Capacity Building Program: Training for client staff on framework maintenance and procurement evaluation
Final Review & Validation with the Client
DELIVERABLE 4: FINAL REPORT (Specs, Bidding Docs, Transition Plan) (Due Week 35)
